title: Multi-Agent Learning with Cooperation-Driven Optimization Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.16917v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multilayer Artificial Neural Networks trained via backpropagation are the basic blocks of many, more complex, classification algorithms. Their strength lies in the possibility of realizing, with arbitrary precision, any function. This result comes at the cost of the large number of involved parameters to be optimized. In this work, we propose a mechanism for cooperation, i.e., information exchange among several artificial neural networks, with the goal of reducing model complexity while maintaining performance. More precisely, we consider several "small" agents, i.e., containing fewer parameters than a reference "large" one, that during training share their predictions by incorporating this information into the loss function and thus directly influence weight updates. translated_title: 基于合作驱动优化动力学的多智能体学习
translated_abstract: 通过反向传播训练的多层人工神经网络是许多更复杂分类算法的基本构件。它们的优势在于能够以任意精度逼近任何函数，而这一优势的代价是需要优化的大量参数。在本工作中，我们提出了一种合作机制，即在多个人工神经网络之间进行信息交换，目标是在保持性能的同时降低模型复杂度。更具体地说，我们考虑了多个“小”智能体（即所含参数少于参考的“大”模型），它们在训练过程中通过将各自的预测信息纳入损失函数来共享信息，从而直接影响权重更新。我们考虑了多种实现合作的策略，例如投票者模型、多数模型以及基于智能体对自身预测置信度的加权平均模型。
tldr: 提出了一种多智能体合作机制，通过在训练过程中将多个小型神经网络的预测信息融入损失函数以直接影响权重更新，从而在保持性能的同时降低模型复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-agent cooperation mechanism in which small neural networks share their predictions by incorporating them into the loss function during training, directly influencing weight updates to reduce model complexity while maintaining performance.
